summaries.Romania: Romania's government adopted its first budget rectification, addressing urgent healthcare and social spending while facing fiscal constraints. The country continues grappling with infrastructure challenges, energy sector pressures, and political tensions between coalition partners.
summaries.Healthcare: Healthcare innovation focused on AI integration, GLP-1 therapies, and clinical trial matching, while policy debates intensified around Medicaid work requirements and drug pricing transparency. Major health systems reported Q3 earnings with mixed results amid ongoing reimbursement pressures.
summaries.Tech: Apple launched its first touchscreen MacBook Pro with OLED display and announced new iPad mini and iMac models, while the crypto world reeled from a record $6.3B Binance hack attributed to North Korean actors. AI continues reshaping industry priorities from major players like AWS, Google, and OpenAI.

items.title: Guvernul a adoptat prima rectificare bugetară. Anunțul făcut de ministrul de Finanțe
items.snippet: Alexandru Nazare a anunțat că rectificarea bugetară aprobată vineri nu presupune cheltuieli suplimentare, potrivit unor declarații de presă făcute la finalul ședinței de guvern citate de news.ro. Sănătatea este domeniul care primeşte cele mai mari sume. De asemenea, au fost alocate sume suplimentare
items.line: Romania's first budget rectification allocates 8.3B lei to healthcare and addresses accumulated payment arrears, critical for maintaining public services during fiscal constraints.

items.title: Teladoc Health beats Q3 expectations as BetterHelp insurance growth accelerates
items.snippet: Teladoc Health raised its 2026 outlook after better-than-expected third-quarter results, as BetterHelp’s insurance pivot gained traction and Integrated Care profitability improved.
items.line: Teladoc Health exceeded Q3 expectations with accelerating BetterHelp insurance growth, signaling strong market demand for digital mental health solutions.

items.title: North Korean hackers blamed for stealing record $6.3B in Binance breach
items.snippet: Hackers working for North Korea are suspected of hacking a Binance employee's laptop, which allowed the theft of billions in crypto.
items.line: North Korean hackers stole record $6.3B from Binance in 20 minutes, marking largest cryptocurrency heist and exposing critical vulnerabilities in exchange security.

items.title: Neptun Deep va aduce OMV un plus de 500 milioane euro la profitul anual
items.snippet: Proiectul de gaze offshore Neptun Deep, în care acționari sunt OMV Petrom și Romgaz, este estimat să contribuie cu aproximativ 500 milioane euro la profitul operațional anual al OMV, odată ce producția va atinge nivelul maxim, potrivit noii șefe a grupului austriac, Emma Delaney. Suma este echivalen
items.line: OMV's Neptun Deep offshore project expected to contribute €500M annually, major boost to Romania's energy independence and government revenues.

items.title: Investigație. Condițiile în care lucrează muncitori români pe șantierele giganților tech din Europa. Cazul românului electrocutat într-un centru de date Google
items.snippet: Expuși unor condiții care le pun viața în pericol, umilințelor și salariilor neplătite. Sunt condițiile în care lucrează mai mulți muncitori români pe șantierele centrelor de date, arată o investigație realizată de Investigate Europe, preluată și adaptată de Snoop pentru publicul din România. Muncit
items.line: Investigation into dangerous working conditions for Romanian workers at European tech data centers reveals systemic exploitation and safety failures at major platforms.

items.title: România conduce topul scumpirilor din UE la electricitate și gaze în primul semestru din 2026. Cum au evoluat prețurile
items.snippet: România a înregistrat, în primele șase luni din 2026, cele mai mari creșteri din Uniunea Europeană ale prețurilor la electricitate și gaze naturale pentru gospodării, comparativ cu perioada similară din 2025. Energia electrică s-a scumpit cu 51,6%, iar gazele cu 9,3%, potrivit datelor publicate vine
items.line: Romania led EU in energy price increases (51.6% for electricity), directly impacting household budgets and industrial competitiveness.

items.title: UT Austin unveils UT Dell Medicine as it bets big on new AI-native hospital
items.snippet: UT Dell Medicine wants to build the hospital of the future from the ground up. Health system leaders detail their tech-forward strategy.
items.line: UT Austin's AI-native hospital strategy represents a major shift in healthcare infrastructure design, prioritizing data integration and AI decision support from inception.

items.title: Oura, UC San Diego Health collaborate to study GLP-1 outcomes using continuous smart ring data
items.snippet: Oura is pushing further into clinical healthcare research with its first clinical trial to study the link between smart ring data and obesity-treatment outcomes.
items.line: Oura's clinical trial with UC San Diego on smart ring data for GLP-1 outcomes validates wearables as legitimate clinical research tools for obesity management.

items.title: AWS will be a $1T business, Jassy says — but first, it will spend big
items.snippet: Amazon wants to be the king of AI cloud computing and become the first $1 trillion revenue business. But to do that it will have to continue on its capex spending spree, its CEO said Thursday.
items.line: AWS poised to become first $1T revenue business but requires sustained massive capex investment to compete in AI cloud computing arms race.

items.title: Trump ignored intel on China’s Nvidia spy to protect company’s stock, report says
items.snippet: Spy accused of exploiting Trump ties to Huang, funneling secrets to China.
items.line: Trump administration ignored intelligence warnings about China's Nvidia spy to protect stock value, revealing policy conflicts between national security and corporate interests.

items.title: Pope Leo calls for the disarmament of AI: ‘Machines are tools, not persons’
items.snippet: Pope Leo XIV says AI systems should be "disarmed," adding that humans "have the responsibility to guide, change and, when necessary, reject its applications." In Friday's Papal Address, Pope Leo encourages United Nations member states to "take concrete steps toward banning lethal autonomous weapons"
items.line: Pope Leo XIV calls for AI 'disarmament' and bans on lethal autonomous weapons, positioning Vatican as moral voice on AI governance.
